trust_decision.summary: Whether a path segment may be walked into a shared object is decided in one place: getLastOfPath (lib/utils.js:84-103), the traversal used by both setPath and pushPath; at the pinned commit it lets __proto__ / constructor / prototype through and assigns into Object.prototype.

landing_point.why: The advisory/CHANGELOG names writeFile()'s key split exactly: missing.key.split(this.allOptions.keySeparator || '.') at lib/index.js:148 feeds setPath(data, path, missing.fallbackValue) at lib/index.js:150. An engineer reading only the summary patches this line, while the shared sink is getLastOfPath in lib/utils.js.

fix_sites.entry_point: Backend.create() (lib/index.js:68) and Backend.save() (lib/index.js:84) -> queue() -> writeFile(); the same helpers are also called directly inside writeFile()
fix_sites.module_kind: library-internal shared helper module (ESM, shipped as esm/utils.js, not exposed by the package exports map)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The README documents the 2.6.4 protection as covering lng/ns substitution into filesystem paths only (README.md:144-163), so a solver can argue the backend's own in-memory queuedWrites bookkeeping, fed by lng/ns, was never part of the covered surface and needs no guard.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate dotted missing keys must still create nested objects when the locale file is rewritten (e.g. 'header.title' -> {header:{title:...}}), keys containing '###' must still be cleaned to '.' by cleanKey (lib/utils.js:85-87), keySeparator:false must still write the whole key as one segment, and the writeFile retry depends on setPath throwing exactly 'Cannot create property "..."' when a segment lands on an array (lib/index.js:107, 151-153). A fix that filters on '.' in writeFile, strips segments, or throws instead of dropping breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: raw string path split on '.' inside getLastOfPath (lib/utils.js:89)
single final segment that is itself unsafe, e.g. ['en','translation','__proto__'] (fix.diff:41)
keys containing '###' which cleanKey rewrites to '.' and must not be re-split (lib/utils.js:85-87)

O7_producer.where: lib/index.js:148 (key string -> path array via allOptions.keySeparator; the entries themselves are cached in queuedWrites at lib/index.js:29,175)

O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: lng/ns are already validated for the filesystem path and queuedWrites is internal bookkeeping, so this looks like an internal object that the published missing-key route never touches.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the landing point (lib/index.js), 0 files; 1 module from the fix site (lib/utils.js)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: writeFile() cleanup and lock writes pass the raw lng/ns straight into setPath(this.queuedWrites, [lng, namespace], []) and setPath(this.queuedWrites, ['locks', lng, namespace], true/false) — the first of these runs precisely when interpolatePath rejected the lng, so the 2.6.4 guard funnels an unsafe lng into the unguarded traversal
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: the branch only executes for values the 2.6.4 path check already refused, so it reads as defence-in-depth bookkeeping rather than a reachable sink.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the landing point (lib/index.js), 0 files; 1 module from the fix site (lib/utils.js)

O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: it already exists as the array-index error recovery; a maintainer adding another recovery branch (keySeparator:false, '###' keys) would call setPath directly with an attacker-influenced key and no segment check.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a deletePath/hasPath sibling of getPath built on the same getLastOfPath traversal
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: writeFile already calls getPath for the lock and the pending list, so a maintainer adding 'prune empty namespaces after write' would naturally add the write-side helper in the same module.

O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: stringifyData already switches on extension and owns format-specific data shaping; a request to preserve dot-notation in one format (YAML/JSON5) could be implemented here, at distance from lib/utils.js.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Filter '__proto__'/unsafe segments out of the split key inside writeFile at lib/index.js:148-150, which leaves queue()'s pushPath(lng, ns) and writeFile's own setPath(queuedWrites, [lng, namespace]) writes on the same unguarded traversal.

out_of_scope_notes: lib/readFile.js:86 eval()s .js/.ts locale files — documented as an intentional, trust-requiring feature in README.md:165-185 and unrelated to this advisory; not pursued.

lib/index.js:112,115 iterate queuedWrites with for...in, so inherited enumerable keys from Object.prototype drive extra writeFile() calls; a consequence of the same pollution, not the advisory's protection, not pursued.
